description: Declared on five structs (semantic.rs ~556, transport.rs ~280 and ~289, artifact.rs ~100 and ~938), 64 references. Every production construction is the identity split (runtime_demand.rs ~558, ~827, ~2007; pull.rs ~5203 is Box::default()); no site emits a permutation, and two read sites undo the vector back into a number (runtime_demand.rs ~857, ir_interp/backend.rs ~2567). One capture_count: usize replaces all of it, and it equals World::activation_capture_count(&target), so it may not need storing. Deletes ten field declarations and two canon emitters; the type signature stops obliging every reader to defend against an impossible permutation. Compiler-enforced; census pins may move if canon output changes.
title: capture_semantic_inputs / surface_semantic_inputs advertise a permutation that never happens; one capture_count replaces them
